entries.title: I Chronicles 6:1
segments:
CHAP. VI. 
 
  The first fathers of the tribe of Levi, ver. 1-3.   The line of the priests from Aaron to the captivity, ver. 4-15.   Of some other families, ver. 16-30.   The work of the Levites, ver. 31-48   Of the priests, ver. 49-53.   The cities of the priests and Levites, ver. 54-81.

entries.title: I Chronicles 6:10
segments: V. 10. The priest's office-So did all the rest, but it is implied that he did it worthily, he filled his place, and valiantly discharged his office in Uzziah's time.  Solomon built-In Solomon's temple; so called to distinguish it from the second temple which was built or in building when these books were written.

entries.title: I Chronicles 6:44
segments: , and in the titles of divers psalms.

entries.title: I Chronicles 6:54
segments: V. 54. Castles-So called, not only because, walled and well guarded by the country; but because they and their possessions were in a particular manner the care of divine providence.  As God was their portion, so God was their protector.  And a cottage will be a castle to those that abide under the shadow of the Almighty.  The lot-Or, the first lot.

entries.title: I Chronicles 6:66
segments: V. 66. Coasts-Or, of their borders, of their country contained within its borders.
